title_as_printed: Memoir on the Island of Socotra
author: J. R. Wellsted
journal: Journal of the Royal Geographical Society of London
heading_as_printed: The following Words and Phrases in the Socotran and Arabic are given as a Specimen of the Language of that Island.
about: Words and phrases in use among the Bedouins of Socotra, collected by Lieutenant Wellsted during his survey of the island and printed with Arabic equivalents.
